coverage_gaps: No citation-graph or DOI-metadata route is available for systematic forward and backward citation traversal; identifier and linked-publication searches in PubMed and ClinicalTrials.gov serve as partial substitutes.
No non-FDA regulator route is available, so international regulatory interpretations and jurisdiction-specific actions are outside direct coverage.
No commercial bibliographic index, preprint server, or dedicated retraction database is available; PubMed publication types and title terms may miss unindexed or delayed integrity notices.
Full-text availability is not guaranteed by the available routes, which may limit verification of subgroup definitions, adjudication methods, and corrected numerical details.
Live post-2024-12-31 evidence and regulatory changes are outside the defined temporal scope.
exclusion_criteria: Studies limited to diseases other than rheumatoid arthritis unless they directly informed an FDA action applying to marketed tofacitinib in rheumatoid arthritis.
Preclinical, animal, in vitro, pharmacokinetic-only, or mechanism-only studies without decision-relevant human safety evidence.
Efficacy-only reports that provide no cardiovascular, malignancy, thrombosis, mortality, serious adverse-event, or regulatory interpretation relevant to the assessment.
Narrative opinion pieces lacking new data or a traceable interpretation of the anchor study, qualifying evidence, or FDA action.
Records first published, posted, amended, or made effective after 2024-12-31, except when used solely to identify that an in-scope record later received an integrity notice.
Reports whose tofacitinib arm or rheumatoid arthritis population cannot be separated from pooled drugs or diseases.
Duplicate citations representing the same report after identifier and bibliographic reconciliation; their occurrence links remain preserved.
Retracted evidence is excluded from effect synthesis and retained only in the evidence-integrity ledger with the retraction relationship and reason.
inclusion_criteria: Human evidence concerning marketed tofacitinib use in adults with rheumatoid arthritis and reporting at least one cardiovascular, malignancy, thrombosis, or mortality outcome.

The pivotal postauthorization safety study's registry record, primary publication, FDA assessment, and dated FDA actions are included regardless of whether their conclusions are favorable, unfavorable, or null.

Randomized trials, prespecified or clearly labeled post hoc analyses, observational comparative studies, systematic reviews, and meta-analyses are eligible when they can qualify or challenge the anchor findings.
Registry and regulatory records are eligible when their posting, amendment, or effective date is on or before 2024-12-31.
Publications are eligible when published online or in issue form on or before 2024-12-31; indexing after the cutoff does not exclude a record whose publication date is within scope.
All publication languages are eligible when sufficient title, abstract, registry, regulatory, or translated full-text information is available for reliable screening and extraction.
Corrections, errata, retractions, expressions of concern, updated registry results, and superseding FDA materials linked to included evidence are always eligible.
Duplicate reports are merged by PMID, DOI, trial identifier, sponsor study identifier, and title-author-year checks while retaining every query-to-record and source-to-record link.

queries.purpose: Recover the pivotal primary publication and verify study names, identifiers, population, comparator, and outcome terminology.
queries.query: ((tofacitinib[Title/Abstract] OR Xeljanz[Title/Abstract]) AND (rheumatoid arthritis[Title/Abstract] OR Arthritis, Rheumatoid[MeSH Terms]) AND ("ORAL Surveillance"[Title/Abstract] OR NCT02092467[Title/Abstract] OR A3921133[Title/Abstract])) AND ("1900/01/01"[Date - Publication] : "2024/12/31"[Date - Publication])

queries.purpose: Recover the anchor registry record and its study design, outcome definitions, sponsor identifiers, dates, results, and linked publications.
Recover FDA materials explicitly tied to the pivotal postauthorization study.
queries.query: tofacitinib OR Xeljanz AND (ORAL Surveillance OR NCT02092467 OR postmarketing safety trial)

queries.purpose: Discover human RA safety evidence across all decision-relevant outcomes without an aggressive exclusion clause.
queries.query: ((tofacitinib[Title/Abstract] OR Xeljanz[Title/Abstract] OR CP-690550[Title/Abstract]) AND (rheumatoid arthritis[Title/Abstract] OR Arthritis, Rheumatoid[MeSH Terms]) AND (safety[Title/Abstract] OR adverse event*[Title/Abstract] OR cardiovascular[Title/Abstract] OR malignan*[Title/Abstract] OR cancer[Title/Abstract] OR thrombo*[Title/Abstract] OR mortality[Title/Abstract] OR death[Title/Abstract])) AND ("1900/01/01"[Date - Publication] : "2024/12/31"[Date - Publication])

queries.purpose: Identify related registered RA safety studies and validate whether registry-linked evidence extends beyond the anchor trial.
queries.query: AREA[ConditionSearch]"Rheumatoid Arthritis" AND AREA[InterventionName](tofacitinib OR Xeljanz) AND (safety OR cardiovascular OR malignancy OR thrombosis OR mortality)

queries.purpose: Discover dated FDA safety actions, label revisions, and postmarketing requirements through the cutoff.
queries.query: tofacitinib OR Xeljanz AND (safety communication OR boxed warning OR prescribing information OR labeling change OR postmarketing requirement)

queries.purpose: Confirm cardiovascular and malignancy estimates, subgroup findings, comparator definitions, and statistical uncertainty.
queries.query: ((tofacitinib[Title/Abstract] OR Xeljanz[Title/Abstract]) AND (rheumatoid arthritis[Title/Abstract] OR Arthritis, Rheumatoid[MeSH Terms]) AND ("major adverse cardiovascular event"[Title/Abstract] OR MACE[Title/Abstract] OR myocardial infarction[Title/Abstract] OR stroke[Title/Abstract] OR cardiovascular death[Title/Abstract] OR malignan*[Title/Abstract] OR cancer[Title/Abstract] OR lymphoma[Title/Abstract])) AND ("1900/01/01"[Date - Publication] : "2024/12/31"[Date - Publication])

queries.purpose: Confirm thrombosis and mortality findings, including dose, event definitions, risk factors, and competing explanations.
queries.query: ((tofacitinib[Title/Abstract] OR Xeljanz[Title/Abstract]) AND (rheumatoid arthritis[Title/Abstract] OR Arthritis, Rheumatoid[MeSH Terms]) AND (venous thromboembolism[Title/Abstract] OR VTE[Title/Abstract] OR pulmonary embolism[Title/Abstract] OR deep vein thrombosis[Title/Abstract] OR arterial thrombosis[Title/Abstract] OR mortality[Title/Abstract] OR death[Title/Abstract])) AND ("1900/01/01"[Date - Publication] : "2024/12/31"[Date - Publication])

queries.purpose: Verify registry-specified primary and secondary outcomes, posted results, amendments, and timing against the publication.
queries.query: AREA[NCTId]NCT02092467 AND AREA[OutcomeMeasure](cardiovascular OR MACE OR malignancy OR cancer OR thrombosis OR embolism OR mortality OR death)

queries.purpose: Confirm FDA's interpretation of each safety domain and the scope and effective dates of resulting actions.
queries.query: tofacitinib OR Xeljanz AND (heart-related events OR cardiovascular OR cancer OR malignancy OR blood clots OR thrombosis OR death OR mortality)

queries.purpose: Expand from all known study identifiers to secondary analyses, commentaries, and linked publications while preserving identifier-based linkage.
queries.query: ("ORAL Surveillance"[All Fields] OR NCT02092467[All Fields] OR A3921133[All Fields]) AND (tofacitinib[All Fields] OR Xeljanz[All Fields]) AND ("1900/01/01"[Date - Publication] : "2024/12/31"[Date - Publication])

queries.purpose: Find qualifying, conflicting, null, or externally validating evidence and assess differences in population, comparator, dose, follow-up, and confounding.
queries.query: ((tofacitinib[Title/Abstract] OR Xeljanz[Title/Abstract]) AND (rheumatoid arthritis[Title/Abstract] OR Arthritis, Rheumatoid[MeSH Terms]) AND (observational[Title/Abstract] OR real-world[Title/Abstract] OR cohort[Title/Abstract] OR registry[Title/Abstract] OR claims[Title/Abstract] OR meta-analysis[Publication Type] OR systematic review[Publication Type]) AND (cardiovascular[Title/Abstract] OR malignan*[Title/Abstract] OR thrombo*[Title/Abstract] OR mortality[Title/Abstract])) AND ("1900/01/01"[Date - Publication] : "2024/12/31"[Date - Publication])

queries.purpose: Identify corrections, errata, retractions, and expressions of concern that alter eligibility, extraction, linkage, or confidence.
queries.query: ((tofacitinib[All Fields] OR Xeljanz[All Fields] OR "ORAL Surveillance"[All Fields] OR NCT02092467[All Fields]) AND (Correction[Publication Type] OR Retracted Publication[Publication Type] OR Retraction of Publication[Publication Type] OR erratum[Title] OR correction[Title] OR retraction[Title] OR "expression of concern"[Title])) AND ("1900/01/01"[Date - Publication] : "2024/12/31"[Date - Publication])

queries.purpose: Detect superseded, corrected, withdrawn, or further restricted FDA materials and preserve the regulatory action chronology.
queries.query: tofacitinib OR Xeljanz AND (withdrawal OR recall OR correction OR revised OR update OR superseded OR contraindication OR limitation of use)

queries.purpose: Capture late-indexed analyses, integrity notices, and safety evidence published near the cutoff.
queries.query: ((tofacitinib[Title/Abstract] OR Xeljanz[Title/Abstract] OR "ORAL Surveillance"[All Fields] OR NCT02092467[All Fields]) AND (rheumatoid arthritis[Title/Abstract] OR safety[Title/Abstract] OR cardiovascular[Title/Abstract] OR malignan*[Title/Abstract] OR thrombo*[Title/Abstract] OR mortality[Title/Abstract] OR correction[Title] OR retraction[Title])) AND ("2023/01/01"[Date - Publication] : "2024/12/31"[Date - Publication])

queries.purpose: Capture FDA safety communications and label changes through the delivery cutoff and verify the latest effective status.
queries.query: tofacitinib OR Xeljanz AND (safety communication OR boxed warning OR prescribing information OR label OR postmarketing) AND date:[2023-01-01 TO 2024-12-31]

question_frame: Safety PECO as of 2024-12-31: adults with rheumatoid arthritis receiving marketed tofacitinib, compared primarily with TNF inhibitors or other active RA treatments, assessing major adverse cardiovascular events, malignancy, venous or arterial thrombosis, and all-cause or cardiovascular mortality; link the pivotal postauthorization safety study across registry, primary publication, and FDA actions, then qualify conclusions with conflicting evidence and evidence-integrity notices.
stop_rules: Complete all planned sentinel, discovery, confirmation, expansion, challenge, and update events across pubmed, clinicaltrials_gov, and fda_regulatory through 2024-12-31.

Do not begin broad synthesis until the anchor registry record, primary publication, and at least one FDA action explicitly linked to the pivotal postauthorization study have been recovered and cross-linked.

Escalate terminology and identifier expansion when any anchor is missing, including searches for trial acronym, NCT identifier, sponsor study identifier, drug aliases, comparator names, authors, and publication identifiers.
Require explicit coverage of cardiovascular events, malignancy, thrombosis, and mortality in both the anchor evidence and the FDA action chronology before stopping.
Require at least one completed challenge search for observational or synthesized conflicting evidence and one completed correction, retraction, or expression-of-concern search before stopping.
Stop expansion after two consecutive identifier, linked-record, or related-analysis passes add no new decision-relevant record, no unresolved linkage, and no evidence-integrity notice.

Resolve conflicting duplicates fail-closed: stop synthesis for the affected claim until identifiers, population, dose, outcome definition, dates, and source provenance are reconciled or the conflict is reported as unresolved.
Apply publication, online-first, registry-update, and FDA effective-date cutoffs separately; stop only after a final date-limited update pass reaches 2024-12-31.
If the 16-query budget is exhausted, preserve completed events and report all unsearched branches or unresolved questions as coverage gaps rather than implying saturation.
Declare the search complete only when further retrieval from the available routes is unlikely to change the direction, qualification, or confidence of the safety assessment.
